category: Implement and Maintain Secure Environments for Software Development (PO)
subcategory_text: Monitor and audit the secure development environments for unauthorized access, misuse, or compromise, and respond to detected anomalies.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-2, AU-2, IR-4, SI-4
implementation_examples: Centralise audit logs from build and source-control systems
Alert on anomalous access (e.g., off-hours, foreign IP) to development infrastructure
Run periodic red-team exercises against the build environment
assessment_objectives: Determine whether development environments are monitored and audited.
Determine whether detected anomalies are responded to per defined procedures.
